scientific_integrity: Exact circuit/edge-contraction proof and integral equivariant duality; reproducible finite tests are corroborative. Earlier pointed-complex result is explicitly attributed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple base graphs with no isolated vertices; three-clique-free complexes of one-private-vertex-per-edge extensions only. Natural base-automorphism action, not full enlarged automorphism group or equivariant homotopy; no direct pure collapse claim and no independent validation. Triangle-free nonequivariant sphere already known from 2006.
title: Triangle detection and integral orientation in edge-triangulated clique-free complexes
